task.title: Explain grouping granularity
task.statement: Explain why the grouping key determines the number of result rows.
expected_evidence: Connect the grouping key to result granularity.

hidden_variables.name: none
hidden_variables.purpose: No hidden execution data is needed.

rubric.criterion: Connects GROUP BY keys to one output group per key.

hints: Name the entity represented by one row.
Relate each group to one grouping-key value.
Explain how multiple input rows become one group.
private.reference_explanation: GROUP BY creates one group for each distinct grouping-key value, so the output has one row per group.
private.solution_explanation: The grouping key defines result granularity.
